isolation: two independent reviewer contexts, no implementation transcript or cross-review conclusions

findings.summary: Colon-bearing target and quote IDs produce duplicate option IDs, allowing wrong-target approval.
findings.reproduction: Targets A and A:X, quotes X:Q and Q, feasible and conditional options both emergency:A:X:Q.
findings.disposition: reproduced; v3 uses SHA-256 of typed JSON tuples plus an aggregation uniqueness check

findings.summary: A future inbound sharing an inventory ID is treated as physical stock.
findings.reproduction: Rename POL-2 to ST-C100; zero physical source stock and future confirmed inbound; v2 can transfer it early.
findings.disposition: reproduced; v3 parser refuses ambiguous resource IDs across inventory, inbound and quotes

findings.summary: A second physical stock can be reassigned to C while B silently loses its replacement margin. Source-ID changes can also cause false rejection for interchangeable physical stock.
findings.disposition: reproduced; v3 follows total physical coverage per commitment and iterates replacement deadlines until no additional displaced commitment is discovered
